grades.quote: Instructions are provided to move bit patterns between the floating-point and integer registers. FMV.X.W moves the single-precision value in floating-point register _rs1_ represented in IEEE 754-2008 encoding to the lower 32 bits of integer register _rd_ . The bits are not modified in the transfer, and in particular, the payloads of non-canonical NaNs are preserved.
grades.reason: Directly describes raw-bit transfers using FMV.X.W and FMV.W.X, explicitly preserving bit patterns.

grades.quote: `MOVFR2GR.D` writes the 64-bit value of the floating-point register `fj` into the general register `rd` .
grades.reason: Directly identifies floating-point-to-integer register bit transfers, including 32-bit variants with sign extension.
Describes numerical conversions and floating-point sign injection, not raw-bit transfers between integer and floating-point registers.

grades.quote: `MOVGR2FR.D` writes the 64-bit value of general register `rj` into floating-point register `fd` .
grades.reason: Directly describes integer-to-floating-point register bit transfers, including full-width and 32-bit-half moves.
